name: Movieshelf
tagline: Catalog your DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs
description: Movieshelf is a collector-first iPhone app for physical media. Scan a barcode to catalog DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs, organize by shelf, and rediscover the films you own.

author.name: Chetan Nagaraja
author.bio: Physical media collector and the developer behind Movieshelf, an iPhone app for cataloging DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs.

blog.title: The Movieshelf Blog
blog.description: Guides for people who still buy discs: cataloging, shelving, editions, formats and getting the most out of a physical movie collection.
